---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible LiDB defect (never include secrets)
title: 'fix: '
labels: bug
---

## Environment
Linux distro/version, kernel, CPU architecture, LiDB version/commit. Include GPU/runtime/driver only if relevant.

## Expected vs observed
Explain behavior and timestamps; label simulated vs real hardware.

## Reproduction
Small safe steps on a host you are authorized to test. Do not attach sensitive payloads or credentials.

## Evidence
Redacted CLI output, support-state reasons and exact log messages.

## Safety impact
Does this expose data, require unexpected permissions or cause significant resource use? For suspected security vulnerabilities, follow SECURITY.md instead of this public issue.
